operatingStatus.basis: Search-indexed official Louis Vuitton restaurant record explicitly has Closed in its title. Fresh fetches of US, Thai and Singapore restaurant location URLs return 404. Fresh US and Thai store directories omit this restaurant while retaining the separate Le Cafe Louis Vuitton. The older Malaysian editorial still links the now-missing SevenRooms experience.
operatingStatus.limitation: The closure wording is available in the indexed official page, not a currently renderable location page. No closure date or reopening status is inferred. The contradictory older editorial is not evidence of current operation.

evidence.observation: Indexed official location record identifies the Gaysorn Amarin address and labels this restaurant Closed. Fresh direct fetch returns 404.
Restaurant section links the exact SevenRooms experience above; cafe has a separate link. Editorial is still available but not proof of current restaurant operation.
Browser rendered SevenRooms page-not-found message and Go Back link; no date, party-size, time, guest or payment controls. Web fetch also returned 404.
Fresh directory includes LV The Place Bangkok and its separate cafe, but not Gaggan at Louis Vuitton.
Indexed older version includes Gaggan with Closed label; fresh retrieved version omits it. This difference is retained rather than presenting cached content as live.
Gaggan's own site gives a Sukhumvit 31 address and a separate request-table route, confirming that it is not the Louis Vuitton Gaysorn Amarin entity.

proposedRecord.blocker: Officially linked SevenRooms experience no longer exists; official indexed location is marked closed and current directories omit the restaurant.
proposedRecord.next: Coordinator may accept a documented unavailable/closed-indicated outcome. Reopen only on new official evidence of this exact restaurant's operation and a working official booking route. Do not substitute Gaggan or Le Cafe Louis Vuitton.
